_comment: Experiment 2: is 64 segments too many? 64 piecewise-constant controls x 3 = 192 free values fitting 64 position points leaves room for a path that threads the points on a wandering route. Fewer knots make that geometrically harder. n_segments also sets the supervision grid (Q=N), so these arms are scored on the shared common-grid metric, not on their own N.
